STANDARD
Works immediately without setup. Measurements stay on this device.

ADB TURBO
The tier is reserved for verified elevated diagnostic access. This first build does not install an ADB helper or grant permissions. A one-time Android permission is not permanent shell access.

ROOT
Only actual root process authority counts. This app does not run su or ask a root manager. A rooted device may still show STANDARD because the app itself is unprivileged.

No computer is required to use this read-only release.
